#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Ganti ~/.obscurify_key ke key berikutnya yang masih bersaldo."""
import json, os, urllib.request
KEYF = os.path.expanduser("~/.obscurify_key")
ACC = "/workspace/project/ob_accounts.txt"
cur = open(KEYF).read().strip() if os.path.exists(KEYF) else ""
def bal(k):
    try:
        r = urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/get_user_balance",
                                   headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {k}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=20) as x:
            return float(json.load(x)["balance"])
    except Exception:
        return -1.0
print("saldo key sekarang:", bal(cur))
for line in open(ACC):
    p = [x.strip() for x in line.split("|")]
    if len(p) >= 3 and p[1].startswith("sk-obs1") and p[1] != cur:
        b = bal(p[1])
        if b >= 0.9:
            open(KEYF, "w").write(p[1]); os.chmod(KEYF, 0o600)
            print(f"ganti ke akun {p[0]} saldo {b}"); break
else:
    print("tidak ada key bersaldo")
PY
